name: Exodus
tagline: All-in-one app to secure, manage, and exchange blockchain assets
blurb: CONTROL YOUR KEYS: Exodus encrypts private keys and transaction data locally for your eyes only.
description:
CONTROL YOUR KEYS: Exodus encrypts private keys and transaction data locally for your eyes only. Your data remains private - no account setup required.

BEAUTIFUL LIVE CHARTS: Track the value of your blockchain asset portfolio, in real time, as market conditions change.

PERSONALIZED FOR YOU: Like darker themes? How about a subtle space background? Exodus gives you a personal look with everything from traditional gray to patterns or customized themes.
